title: Asymmetric On-Policy Distillation Learns In-Context Exploration
title_zh: 非对称同策略蒸馏学习上下文内探索

paragraphs.en: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is difficult because agents must explore to infer hidden, task-relevant information before acting effectively. Learning such information-gathering behaviors tabula rasa via online reinforcement learning is sample-inefficient, whereas offline imitation averages expert actions across hidden states and fails to learn exploration. In this work, we propose ASTEROID, a simple and effective student–teacher supervised learning framework that can learn test-time exploration. Although a privileged expert never needs to explore, we demonstrate that a history-conditioned student can learn to do so when trained with on-policy contexts: the student first collects on-policy context under partial observability, and the privileged expert provides action labels conditioned on that context. By distilling expert actions directly conditioned on the student’s on-policy history, the student learns to systematically resolve partial observability, i.e., search while uncertain and exploit once the hidden state is revealed. This enables efficient test-time exploration (similar to Bayesian posterior sampling) without incurring the impractical training-data costs of reinforcement learning. Across a diverse range of eleven different environments, including discrete exploration benchmarks, robotic manipulation, navigation, and Procgen environments, ASTEROID achieves ∼ \sim 2 × \times higher returns under fixed exploration budgets, uses up to ∼ \sim 100 × \times fewer interactions than RL baselines, and outperforms frontier models at exploration. Finally, our method transfers policies trained in simulation to vision-denied real-world robot manipulation, exhibiting efficient exploration and increasing success by + 40 % +40\% over standard distillation. Overall, it provides a simple yet surprisingly effective framework to learn efficient test-time exploration.

paragraphs.en: Sequential decision-making under partial observability is a central challenge in reinforcement learning (RL) [ 34 , 53 ] . In the real world, from robotics to embodied AI, agents receive only partial, noisy observations of the environment. To act successfully, agents must first explore to uncover hidden, task-relevant information [ 31 , 79 , 42 , 74 , 46 , 71 ] . For example, a household robot searching for an object must use onboard sensing to infer likely object locations, track locations it has already searched, and adapt future exploration based on prior attempts [ 12 , 11 , 30 ] . These problems are formalized as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) [ 34 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 部分可观测下的序贯决策是强化学习（RL）中的核心挑战 [ 34 , 53 ] 。 在现实世界中，从机器人技术到具身智能（Embodied AI），智能体只能接收到环境的部分、含噪声的观测。 为了成功行动，智能体必须首先进行探索，以揭示隐藏的、与任务相关的信息 [ 31 , 79 , 42 , 74 , 46 , 71 ] 。 例如，一个寻找物体的家用机器人必须利用机载传感来推断物体可能的位置，追踪自己已经搜索过的位置，并根据先前的尝试调整未来的探索 [ 12 , 11 , 30 ] 。 这些问题被形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）[ 34 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Solving these tasks requires policies with memory [ 28 , 50 ] . Learning them from scratch via recurrent RL is sample-inefficient, since the agent must learn to gather information and exploit it at the same time [ 5 , 79 , 21 ] . One way to improve sample efficiency is to assume training-time access to a privileged expert that observes the hidden state and acts accordingly. For example, in household navigation, an oracle planner could use the full map of the training environments, which is unavailable at deployment. In practice, these teachers can be trained in fully observed tasks using RL, imitation learning, or hybrid approaches [ 78 , 75 , 60 , 27 , 52 ] . This expert can teach the student how to act once the hidden state is known, but not how to find it [ 44 ] . As a result, naively copying the expert does not teach the student to explore [ 70 ] . Interactive imitation [ 65 ] offers a natural fix by relabeling student mistakes with expert actions. However, standard approaches [ 59 ] train the student to predict the average expert action across possible hidden states, so it dithers between hypotheses instead of resolving them [ 37 , 70 ] . Other approaches propose to address the student-teacher mismatch using expensive online RL [ 74 ] , differentiable experts [ 73 ] , or offline coverage assumptions [ 42 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 解决这些任务需要具有记忆的策略 [ 28 , 50 ] 。 通过循环强化学习从零开始学习这些策略的样本效率低下，因为智能体必须同时学会收集信息并加以利用 [ 5 , 79 , 21 ] 。 提高样本效率的一种方法是假设在训练时可以使用一个能观察到隐藏状态并据此行动的特权专家。 例如，在家庭导航中，一个预言者规划器可以使用训练环境的完整地图，而该地图在部署时是不可用的。 在实践中，这些教师可以在完全可观测的任务中通过强化学习、模仿学习或混合方法进行训练 [ 78 , 75 , 60 , 27 , 52 ] 。 这个专家可以教学生在隐藏状态已知后如何行动，却无法教学生如何找到该隐藏状态 [ 44 ] 。 因此，简单地复制专家的行为并不能教会学生进行探索 [ 70 ] 。 交互式模仿 [ 65 ] 通过用专家动作对学生犯的错误进行重标注，提供了一种自然的解决方案。 然而，标准方法 [ 59 ] 训练学生在可能的隐藏状态上预测专家动作的平均值，因此它会在不同假设之间犹豫不决，而不是去解决它们 [ 37 , 70 ] 。 其他方法则提出使用昂贵的在线强化学习 [ 74 ] 、可微分专家 [ 73 ] 或离线覆盖假设 [ 42 ] 来解决学生与教师之间的失配问题。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose ASTEROID ( A symmetric S tudent Te acher R oll- O ut I n-context D istillation), a framework that shows that privileged experts can teach exploration through interactive imitation. The idea is simple: the student generates the history online, and the expert provides the labels. ASTEROID rolls out the current student under partial observability, producing a history of observations, actions, and rewards, then asks the expert what it would do from the state the student has reached. The expert does not explore; it only labels the student’s histories. As a result, failed searches and probes become useful context: they specify evidence accumulated so far, while the expert provides next actions given the hidden state. With on-policy history, the policy can identify inconsistent hypotheses and adapt its exploration and action distribution accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 ASTEROID（非对称师生滚动式上下文蒸馏），一个表明特权专家可以通过交互式模仿来教授探索的框架。 这个想法很简单：学生在在线过程中生成历史，专家提供标签。 ASTEROID 在部分可观测条件下滚动当前的智能体（学生），生成由观测、动作和奖励组成的历史，然后询问专家：在学生所处状态下，专家会怎么做。 专家不进行探索，它只对学生（智能体）的历史进行标注。 因此，失败的搜索与试探都成为有用的上下文：它们指明了迄今积累的证据，而专家在给定隐藏状态的情况下提供下一步动作。 有了同策略的历史，策略（智能体）就能识别不一致的假设，并相应地调整其探索和动作分布。

paragraphs.en: Why does this teach exploration? A partial history represents uncertainty over the hidden state. Returning to household navigation: suppose the object could be in location A A , B B , or C C . If the student searches A A and finds nothing, its history rules out A A but is still consistent with B B and C C . A privileged expert would label this history with search ( B ) when the object is at B B , and search ( C ) when it is at C C . The student therefore learns to act and explore the remaining valid actions: if it fails at A A , it samples search ( B ) or search ( C ) . If it then fails at B B , every label is search ( C ) , since only C C remains. Unlike random sampling of locations, the policy conditions on its history and never retries hypotheses it has ruled out. Across many training tasks, ambiguous histories are labeled with a distribution of potential, consistent expert trajectories. The student samples from this distribution to explore, and each new observation and feedback eliminates additional hypotheses. The key insight: the set of histories that the student needs to learn to adapt from (e.g., failing at A A , failing at B B and then moving to C C ) is entirely covered by on-policy behavior. This is in-context exploration , i.e., searching while uncertain, and exploiting once the hidden state is revealed. Additionally, we show that a curriculum over the student rollout horizon improves sample efficiency and enables longer-context adaptation (Section 5 ). Overall, ASTEROID incorporates very simple changes into standard online student-teacher distillation to enable test-time exploration behavior .
paragraphs.zh: 为什么这能教会探索？ 部分历史表示了对隐藏状态的不确定性。 回到家庭导航的例子：假设物体可能位于位置 A A、B B 或 C C。 如果学生搜索 A A 但一无所获，其历史便排除了 A A，但仍与 B B 和 C C 一致。 拥有特权信息的专家会将这一历史标注为：物体在 B B 时执行 search ( B )，物体在 C C 时执行 search ( C )。 因此，学生学会采取行动并探索剩余的有效动作：如果在 A A 失败，它会采样 search ( B ) 或 search ( C )。 如果随后在 B B 处失败，由于只剩下 C C，所有标签都是 search ( C )。 与随机采样位置不同，该策略以其历史为条件，绝不会重试已被其排除的假设。 在众多训练任务中，模糊的历史会用一组潜在的、一致的专家轨迹分布来标注。 学生从这个分布中采样以进行探索，而每次新的观察和反馈都会消除更多的假设。 关键洞察在于：学生需要学会据此进行适应的那组历史（例如，在 A A 失败、在 B B 失败然后转向 C C）完全被同策略行为所覆盖。 这就是上下文内探索，即在不确定时进行搜索，并在隐藏状态被揭示后进行利用。 此外，我们证明了对学生 rollout 范围采用课程学习可以提升样本效率，并支持更长上下文的适应（第 5 节）。 总体而言，ASTEROID 在标准的在线学生-教师蒸馏中融入了非常简单的改动，从而实现了测试时的探索行为。

sents.en: The student samples from this distribution to explore, and each new observation and feedback eliminates additional hypotheses.
sents.zh: 学生从这个分布中采样以进行探索，而每次新的观察和反馈都会消除更多的假设。

sents.en: The key insight: the set of histories that the student needs to learn to adapt from (e.g., failing at A A , failing at B B and then moving to C C ) is entirely covered by on-policy behavior.
sents.zh: 关键洞察在于：学生需要学会据此进行适应的那组历史（例如，在 A A 失败、在 B B 失败然后转向 C C）完全被同策略行为所覆盖。

sents.en: This is in-context exploration , i.e., searching while uncertain, and exploiting once the hidden state is revealed.
sents.zh: 这就是上下文内探索，即在不确定时进行搜索，并在隐藏状态被揭示后进行利用。

sents.en: Additionally, we show that a curriculum over the student rollout horizon improves sample efficiency and enables longer-context adaptation (Section 5 ).
sents.zh: 此外，我们证明了对学生 rollout 范围采用课程学习可以提升样本效率，并支持更长上下文的适应（第 5 节）。

sents.en: Overall, ASTEROID incorporates very simple changes into standard online student-teacher distillation to enable test-time exploration behavior .
sents.zh: 总体而言，ASTEROID 在标准的在线学生-教师蒸馏中融入了非常简单的改动，从而实现了测试时的探索行为。

paragraphs.en: We show both empirically (Section 6 ) and theoretically (Appendix H ) that ASTEROID approximates Bayesian posterior sampling, a provably efficient exploration strategy [ 53 ] . However, posterior sampling has been hard to scale: prior approaches maintain an explicit posterior [ 3 ] or assume infinite offline data [ 42 ] , which are intractable in realistic settings. ASTEROID avoids both: it does not maintain an explicit posterior, and on-policy supervised learning avoids impractical data costs. Because it is a simple extension of student–teacher distillation, ASTEROID works with modern architectures and existing sim-to-real frameworks [ 75 ] . In summary, we make the following contributions:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在实验上（第 6 节）和理论上（附录 H）都证明了 ASTEROID 近似于贝叶斯后验采样，这是一种可被证明高效的探索策略 [53]。 然而，后验采样一直难以扩展：先前的方法要么维护显式后验 [3]，要么假设拥有无限的离线数据 [42]，这些在现实场景中都难以处理。 ASTEROID 避开了这两点：它不维护显式后验，并且通过在线监督学习避免了不切实际的数据成本。 由于它只是学生–教师蒸馏的简单扩展，ASTEROID 可以与现代架构以及现有的仿真到真实（sim-to-real）框架 [75] 配合使用。 总而言之，我们做出了以下贡献：

sents.en: Because it is a simple extension of student–teacher distillation, ASTEROID works with modern architectures and existing sim-to-real frameworks [ 75 ] .

sents.en: In summary, we make the following contributions:
sents.zh: 总而言之，我们做出了以下贡献：

paragraphs.en: We present ASTEROID, a simple student–teacher distillation framework that enables in-context exploration and test-time improvement learned solely from privileged experts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 ASTEROID，一个简单的学生–教师蒸馏框架，能够实现情境探索和测试时改进，且仅从拥有特权信息的专家那里学习。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our method across 11 environments, including navigation in realistic household simulators and real-world robot manipulation, where it outperforms RL and supervised baselines under fixed exploration budgets while using two orders of magnitude fewer training interactions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 11 个环境中评估了我们的方法，包括在真实的家庭模拟器中导航和真实世界的机器人操作。在固定的探索预算下，我们的方法优于强化学习和监督基线，同时使用的训练交互次数少了两个数量级。

paragraphs.en: We show that learned policies exhibit efficient real-world exploration and, under appropriate assumptions, recover posterior sampling with error linear rather than quadratic in context length.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了学习到的策略能够实现高效的真实世界探索，并且在适当的假设下，可以恢复后验采样，其误差与上下文长度呈线性而非二次关系。

paragraphs.en: Student–Teacher Distillation. Learning from privileged experts arises in settings from self-driving [ 13 ] to robotic exploration [ 17 ] . Interactive imitation addresses the covariate shift that drives the learner into unseen states [ 59 ] , and prior work suggests that on-policy imitation is necessary under partial observability [ 65 ] . Our work targets this non-realizable regime, where the learner must take information-gathering actions that are not recoverable from a fully observed expert [ 63 , 40 ] . Prior approaches handle this via additional assumptions, such as differentiable experts [ 73 ] , predicting hidden information [ 38 ] , or incorporating RL with bootstrapping to induce exploration [ 74 , 70 , 61 , 37 ] . In contrast, we learn information-gathering behavior using iterative distillation of expert actions conditioned on on-policy histories, which is more sample-efficient than RL-based alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 学生–教师蒸馏。 从特权专家学习出现在从自动驾驶[13]到机器人探索[17]等诸多场景中。 交互式模仿解决了协变量偏移问题，该偏移会使学习者进入未见过的状态[59]，并且先前的工作表明，在部分可观测条件下，同策略模仿是必要的[65]。 我们的工作针对的是这种不可实现的情形，即学习者必须采取信息收集动作，而这些动作无法从完全可观测的专家那里恢复[63, 40]。 先前的方法通过附加假设来处理这一问题，例如可微专家[73]、预测隐藏信息[38]，或者结合带自举的强化学习来引导探索[74, 70, 61, 37]。 相比之下，我们通过对以同策略历史为条件的专家动作进行迭代蒸馏来学习信息收集行为，这比基于强化学习的替代方案更具样本效率。

paragraphs.en: Meta Learning. Meta-RL learns adaptive exploration across task distributions using recurrent policies [ 28 , 21 , 79 , 44 ] , but requires extensive online interaction [ 5 ] , making it difficult to scale to high-dimensional, sparse-reward domains. Our approach replaces this expensive RL-based adaptation with supervised learning, making it efficient to learn long-horizon exploration. Further, unlike prior work limited to Bayes-Adaptive MDPs [ 40 , 79 , 42 ] , our method scales to POMDPs, where the policy explores within a single episode to estimate the underlying state and achieve task success.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习。 元强化学习利用循环策略跨任务分布学习自适应探索 [ 28 , 21 , 79 , 44 ] ，但需要大量的在线交互 [ 5 ] ，因此难以扩展到高维、稀疏奖励的领域。 我们的方法用监督学习取代这种昂贵的基于强化学习的适应，使学习长时程探索变得高效。 此外，与以往仅限于贝叶斯自适应马尔可夫决策过程的工作 [ 40 , 79 , 42 ] 不同，我们的方法可扩展到部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，其中策略在单个回合内进行探索以估计潜在状态并实现任务成功。

paragraphs.en: Posterior Sampling. Posterior sampling methods [ 67 , 53 ] drive exploration by maintaining a belief over hidden parameters, acting optimally under samples from this belief, and updating it based on feedback. Despite strong empirical and theoretical results [ 10 , 53 ] , such approaches require maintaining an explicit posterior and solving for policies under sampled parameters [ 53 , 3 ] , limiting scalability to high-dimensional settings. ASTEROID does not explicitly optimize a posterior-sampling objective. Instead, posterior-sampling-like behavior emerges through iterative on-policy distillation, even in high-dimensional continuous environments (Section 6 ), and we include theoretical insights to show convergence to posterior sampling on the covered history support (Appendix H ). In Section 6 , we show that current frontier models are inefficient at performing such exploration under partial observability, motivating the need to explicitly learn such behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 后验采样。 后验采样方法 [67, 53] 通过在隐参数上维护一个信念来驱动探索，在该信念的采样下采取最优动作，并根据反馈对其进行更新。 尽管这类方法有很强的实证和理论结果 [10, 53]，但它们需要维护显式的后验分布，并在采样参数下求解策略 [53, 3]，这限制了其向高维场景的可扩展性。 ASTEROID 并不显式优化后验采样目标。 相反，类后验采样的行为通过迭代式在策略蒸馏自然涌现，即便在高维连续环境中也是如此（第 6 节），并且我们提供了理论洞见，以表明在所覆盖的历史支撑上收敛到后验采样（附录 H）。 在第 6 节中，我们表明当前的前沿模型在部分可观测条件下进行此类探索时效率低下，这说明了显式学习此类行为的必要性。

paragraphs.en: In-Context Decision-Making. Transformers trained autoregressively on sequential data exhibit in-context learning [ 9 , 25 ] , which Decision Transformer [ 15 ] and Algorithm Distillation [ 39 ] leverage for decision-making. These works focus on using online rollouts as context to adapt behavior without external prompts. Closest to our work, Decision-Pretrained Transformer [ 42 ] learns an in-context policy that performs posterior sampling by pairing randomly generated contexts with privileged expert supervision. Such methods assume the offline dataset covers all possible interaction histories, which is intractable in high-dimensional domains. ASTEROID, instead, uses on-policy contexts, removing the coverage assumption and scaling to much harder, higher-dimensional problems (Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文决策。 在序列数据上以自回归方式训练的 Transformer 表现出上下文学习 [9, 25]，Decision Transformer [15] 和 Algorithm Distillation [39] 正是利用这一点来进行决策。 这些工作专注于使用在线轨迹作为上下文，从而无需外部提示即可调整行为。 与我们的工作最接近的是 Decision-Pretrained Transformer [42]，它通过将随机生成的上下文与特权专家监督配对，学习一种执行后验采样的上下文策略。 这类方法假设离线数据集覆盖了所有可能的交互历史，这在高维领域中是难以实现的。 相反，ASTEROID 使用同策略上下文，去除了覆盖假设，并能扩展到更难、维度更高的问题（第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: We study decision-making under partial observability , modeled as a partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) [ 34 ] . A POMDP is represented by the tuple ( 𝒮 , 𝒜 , 𝒪 , E , T , R , ρ 0 , γ ) (\mathcal{S},\mathcal{A},\mathcal{O},E,T,R,\rho_{0},\gamma) , where 𝒮 \mathcal{S} is the state space, 𝒜 \mathcal{A} is the action space, 𝒪 \mathcal{O} is the observation space and E , T , R , ρ 0 , γ E,T,R,\rho_{0},\gamma are the emission function, transition kernel, reward function, initial state distribution and discount factor, respectively. In a POMDP, the policy does not observe the state s t s_{t} but receives partial observations o t ∼ E ( ⋅ ∣ s t ) o_{t}\sim E(\cdot\mid s_{t}) . For simplicity, we also define the Bayes-Adaptive Markov decision process (BAMDP), a special case of POMDPs in which the only hidden variable is a latent parameter, denoted by z z , i.e., s t = ( o t , z ) s_{t}=(o_{t},z) . For each interaction, z ∈ 𝒵 z\in\mathcal{Z} is sampled from a prior p ⁡ ( z ) p(z) and remains fixed for K K episodes (unlike a POMDP, where hidden states may vary at each step). Given z z , BAMDPs are fully observed and can be represented as a collection of MDPs M z M_{z} (or tasks).
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究部分可观测条件下的决策问题，将其建模为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）[34]。 一个POMDP由元组 (𝒮, 𝒜, 𝒪, E, T, R, ρ₀, γ) 表示，其中 𝒮 是状态空间，𝒜 是动作空间，𝒪 是观测空间，而 E、T、R、ρ₀、γ 分别是发射函数、转移核、奖励函数、初始状态分布和折扣因子。 在POMDP中，策略无法观测到状态 sₜ，只能接收部分观测 oₜ ∼ E(·|sₜ)。 为简单起见，我们还定义了贝叶斯自适应马尔可夫决策过程（BAMDP），它是POMDP的一种特例，其中唯一的隐变量是一个潜在参数，记为 z，即 sₜ = (oₜ, z)。 在每次交互中，z ∈ 𝒵 从先验分布 p(z) 中采样，并在 K 个回合内保持固定（不同于POMDP中隐状态可能在每一步都变化）。 给定 z，BAMDP是完全可观测的，可以表示为一组MDP M_z（或任务）的集合。

paragraphs.en: As a running example, consider a three-door environment: a BAMDP with latent parameter z z denoting the target door. At the start of each interaction, z z is sampled uniformly from the three doors and remains fixed across multiple episodes, where the objective is to navigate to the correct door. The target is hidden, and the agent must use its interaction history to infer the hidden goal and then exploit that information. We can construct a POMDP by adding noise to agent observations at each time step.

paragraphs.en: In the following sections, we focus on the key paradigms for teacher–student distillation under partial observability, discuss why they break down at learning how to explore in asymmetric settings, and motivate ASTEROID as an iterative on-policy distillation method for learning in-context exploration.

paragraphs.en: The above assumption holds in the infinite-data limit, when randomly sampling histories and query observations provides complete coverage (see Figure 2 ). Under finite data, this quickly becomes impractical in high-dimensional observation and action spaces, where the number of possible histories grows exponentially, and informative feedback is sparse [ 6 ] . Consequently, purely offline context datasets do not scale to learning exploration in realistic, large-scale decision-making problems. This has fundamentally limited the applicability of methods like DPT in robotics and other high-dimensional problems.
paragraphs.zh: 上述假设在无限数据极限下成立，即随机采样历史与查询观测能够提供完全覆盖（见图 2）。 在有限数据下，这在高维观测与动作空间中很快变得不切实际，因为可能的历史数量呈指数增长，而有效反馈十分稀疏 [6]。 因此，纯离线的上下文数据集无法扩展到现实的、大规模决策问题中的探索学习。 这从根本上限制了 DPT 这类方法在机器人学及其他高维问题中的适用性。

paragraphs.en: In Section 4 , we identified a central bottleneck in supervised learning for in-context exploration: generating data that covers the histories a partially observed agent will experience at deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 在第4节中，我们指出了监督学习在上下文内探索中的一个核心瓶颈：生成能够覆盖部分可观测的智能体在部署时将经历的历史的数据。

paragraphs.en: Consequently, this relaxes the strong assumption of infinite coverage over histories that renders DPT intractable. Our method ASTEROID is an iterative asymmetric distillation procedure that alternates between collecting on-policy histories from the student and training a history-conditioned student policy from privileged expert labels. Collecting supervision on student-induced histories reduces the distribution shift between training and deployment. Unlike standard interactive imitation [ 59 ] , which aggregates per-step action labels, ASTEROID supervises with full expert trajectories and conditions on environment feedback (Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这放宽了“对历史具有无限覆盖”这一导致 DPT 不可处理的强假设。 我们的方法 ASTEROID 是一种迭代式非对称蒸馏过程，它在从学生收集同策略历史与根据特权专家标签训练以历史为条件的学生策略之间交替进行。 在学生所引发的历史上收集监督信号，可以减少训练与部署之间的分布偏移。 与标准的交互式模仿 [59] 聚合每一步动作标签不同，ASTEROID 使用完整的专家轨迹进行监督，并以环境反馈为条件（附录 D）。

sents.en: Consequently, this relaxes the strong assumption of infinite coverage over histories that renders DPT intractable.
sents.zh: 因此，这放宽了“对历史具有无限覆盖”这一导致 DPT 不可处理的强假设。

sents.en: Our method ASTEROID is an iterative asymmetric distillation procedure that alternates between collecting on-policy histories from the student and training a history-conditioned student policy from privileged expert labels.
sents.zh: 我们的方法 ASTEROID 是一种迭代式非对称蒸馏过程，它在从学生收集同策略历史与根据特权专家标签训练以历史为条件的学生策略之间交替进行。

sents.en: Collecting supervision on student-induced histories reduces the distribution shift between training and deployment.
sents.zh: 在学生所引发的历史上收集监督信号，可以减少训练与部署之间的分布偏移。

sents.en: Unlike standard interactive imitation [ 59 ] , which aggregates per-step action labels, ASTEROID supervises with full expert trajectories and conditions on environment feedback (Appendix D ).
sents.zh: 与标准的交互式模仿 [59] 聚合每一步动作标签不同，ASTEROID 使用完整的专家轨迹进行监督，并以环境反馈为条件（附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: The formal statements and proofs are given in Appendix H . The key step is that privileged labels queried on the student’s own histories are exactly posterior-sampling labels (Lemma 1 ). In addition, we show that an offline in-context learner with the same training error can incur O ⁡ ( ϵ ​ K 2 ) O(\epsilon K^{2}) error (Lemma 2 ), because the test-time histories it encounters drift away from its fixed training distribution.
paragraphs.zh: 形式化的陈述与证明见附录 H。 关键一步是：在学生模型自身历史上查询的特权标签恰好是后验采样标签（引理 1）。 此外，我们证明具有相同训练误差的离线上下文学习者可能产生 O(ε K²) 的误差（引理 2），因为其在测试时遇到的历史会偏离其固定的训练分布。

sents.en: The formal statements and proofs are given in Appendix H .
sents.zh: 形式化的陈述与证明见附录 H。

sents.zh: 关键一步是：在学生模型自身历史上查询的特权标签恰好是后验采样标签（引理 1）。

sents.en: In addition, we show that an offline in-context learner with the same training error can incur O ⁡ ( ϵ ​ K 2 ) O(\epsilon K^{2}) error (Lemma 2 ), because the test-time histories it encounters drift away from its fixed training distribution.

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 and Algorithm 1 summarize ASTEROID. Let π θ k \pi_{\theta_{k}} denote the student policy and 𝒟 k \mathcal{D}_{k} the dataset at iteration k k . We first instantiate the method in a BAMDP, where a latent z ∼ p ⁡ ( z ) z\sim p(z) stays fixed while the policy interacts for k k episodes, and extend it to general POMDPs in Section 5.3 . Each iteration has two phases. In the data generation phase, we roll out the student for k k episodes to produce the on-policy context h = ( τ 0 , … , τ k − 1 ) h=(\tau^{0},\dots,\tau^{k-1}) , then roll out the privileged expert π ∗ ( ⋅ ∣ o , z ) \pi^{*}(\cdot\mid o,z) under the same z z to produce an expert trajectory τ ∗ \tau^{*} . Unlike DPT, which samples query observations randomly, our queries come from expert rollouts. In practice, we use a causal transformer [ 42 ] and compute the loss only on expert actions. We repeat this process of collecting on-policy contexts and expert labels, followed by supervised learning iteratively. After iteration k k , π θ k \pi_{\theta_{k}} adapts using up to k k test-time episodes. Revisiting the three-door problem from Section 3 ,

paragraphs.en: Iteration 0. π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} learns an i.i.d. policy with no in-context learning. It randomly chooses a door every episode, ignoring previous episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 0。π_{θ_0} 学习一个无上下文学习能力的 i.i.d. 策略。 它在每个回合中随机选择一扇门，忽略之前的回合。

sents.en: Iteration 0. π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} learns an i.i.d. policy with no in-context learning.
sents.zh: 迭代 0。π_{θ_0} 学习一个无上下文学习能力的 i.i.d. 策略。

sents.en: It randomly chooses a door every episode, ignoring previous episodes.
sents.zh: 它在每个回合中随机选择一扇门，忽略之前的回合。

paragraphs.en: Iteration 1. π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} generates an on-policy trajectory, which visits a random door. The reward reveals whether that door is correct: + 1 +1 if correct, 0 0 otherwise. The expert label then returns to the same door on success or points to a different door after failure. Thus, π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} learns to use the first episode as context for choosing the second. However, π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} has a context window of one episode, so it cannot reason over more than one attempt, motivating more iterations to expand the window.
paragraphs.zh: 迭代 1。π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} 生成一条同策略轨迹，访问一扇随机的门。 奖励揭示该门是否正确：正确则为 + 1 +1，否则为 0 0。 专家标签随后在成功时回到同一扇门，或在失败后指向另一扇门。 因此，π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} 学会把第一次尝试作为选择第二次的上下文。 然而，π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} 的上下文窗口只有一个回合，因此无法对多于一次尝试进行推理，这促使更多迭代来扩展该窗口。

sents.en: Iteration 1. π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} generates an on-policy trajectory, which visits a random door.
sents.zh: 迭代 1。π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} 生成一条同策略轨迹，访问一扇随机的门。

sents.en: The reward reveals whether that door is correct: + 1 +1 if correct, 0 0 otherwise.
sents.zh: 奖励揭示该门是否正确：正确则为 + 1 +1，否则为 0 0。

sents.en: The expert label then returns to the same door on success or points to a different door after failure.
sents.zh: 专家标签随后在成功时回到同一扇门，或在失败后指向另一扇门。

sents.en: Thus, π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} learns to use the first episode as context for choosing the second.
sents.zh: 因此，π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} 学会把第一次尝试作为选择第二次的上下文。

sents.en: However, π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} has a context window of one episode, so it cannot reason over more than one attempt, motivating more iterations to expand the window.
sents.zh: 然而，π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} 的上下文窗口只有一个回合，因此无法对多于一次尝试进行推理，这促使更多迭代来扩展该窗口。

paragraphs.en: Iteration 2. π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} now generates two context trajectories: it repeats a successful door, or tests a new door after failure. If both tested doors fail, the expert label points to the remaining door. Thus, π θ 2 \pi_{\theta_{2}} learns in-context exploration that identifies the true goal in this partially observed task.
paragraphs.zh: 第 2 次迭代。π θ 1 \pi_{\theta_{1}} 现在会生成两条上下文轨迹：要么重复成功过的门，要么在失败后尝试新的门。 如果两次尝试的门都失败了，专家标签就会指向剩下的那扇门。 因此，π θ 2 \pi_{\theta_{2}} 学会了上下文内探索，能在这个部分可观测的任务中识别出真正的目标。

paragraphs.en: Initialization. We initialize 𝒟 0 \mathcal{D}_{0} with privileged expert trajectories. The initial policy π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} is therefore trained without contextual information and resembles naive student–teacher distillation; see Section 4 .

We do not use any training context; at each step, the policy uses online interaction to build context and infer hidden information. For evaluations longer than the training context length, we use a sliding window.

paragraphs.en: Context-length curriculum. At each iteration k k , the policy is rolled out for k k episodes, inducing a curriculum on rollout horizons. As the horizon expands, the student can eliminate task instances that are inconsistent with its history over a longer horizon, making exploration efficient. This also makes our method more sample-efficient, and we discuss this further in Appendix B.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 上下文长度课程。 在每次迭代 k k 中，策略被展开 k k 个回合，从而在展开时域上引入一种课程。 随着时域的扩展，学生可以在更长的时域上排除与其历史不一致的任务实例，从而提高探索效率。 这也使我们的方法具有更高的样本效率，我们在附录 B.3 中进一步讨论这一点。

sents.zh: 在每次迭代 k k 中，策略被展开 k k 个回合，从而在展开时域上引入一种课程。

sents.en: As the horizon expands, the student can eliminate task instances that are inconsistent with its history over a longer horizon, making exploration efficient.

sents.en: This also makes our method more sample-efficient, and we discuss this further in Appendix B.3 .
sents.zh: 这也使我们的方法具有更高的样本效率，我们在附录 B.3 中进一步讨论这一点。

paragraphs.en: We described ASTEROID in a BAMDP, where a latent variable z z remains fixed across multiple episodes. In a general POMDP, the hidden state evolves within a single episode. For example, in a locally observed maze, the agent does not observe its global position, and this hidden position changes after every move. At test time, the policy interacts with the environment for a single episode over a fixed horizon H H . As the underlying state changes at each step, the agent faces a branching inference problem: each action and observation changes which hidden states remain plausible. Thus, instead of coverage over repeated episodes for a fixed z z , we need coverage over on-policy histories h t h_{t} across timesteps t ∈ [ H ] t\in[H] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个 BAMDP 中描述了 ASTEROID，其中潜在变量 z z 在多个回合中保持固定。 在一般的 POMDP 中，隐藏状态在单个回合内演化。 例如，在一个局部可观测的迷宫中，智能体无法观测其全局位置，而这个隐藏位置在每次移动后都会改变。 在测试时，策略与环境在固定视野 H H 内进行单个回合的交互。 由于底层状态在每一步都会变化，智能体面临一个分支推断问题：每个动作和观测都会改变哪些隐藏状态仍然是可信的。 因此，我们需要的不再是对固定 z z 的重复回合的覆盖，而是在时间步 t ∈ [ H ] t\in[H] 上对同策略历史 h t h_{t} 的覆盖。

sents.en: We described ASTEROID in a BAMDP, where a latent variable z z remains fixed across multiple episodes.
sents.zh: 我们在一个 BAMDP 中描述了 ASTEROID，其中潜在变量 z z 在多个回合中保持固定。

sents.en: In a general POMDP, the hidden state evolves within a single episode.
sents.zh: 在一般的 POMDP 中，隐藏状态在单个回合内演化。

sents.en: For example, in a locally observed maze, the agent does not observe its global position, and this hidden position changes after every move.
sents.zh: 例如，在一个局部可观测的迷宫中，智能体无法观测其全局位置，而这个隐藏位置在每次移动后都会改变。

sents.en: At test time, the policy interacts with the environment for a single episode over a fixed horizon H H .
sents.zh: 在测试时，策略与环境在固定视野 H H 内进行单个回合的交互。

sents.en: As the underlying state changes at each step, the agent faces a branching inference problem: each action and observation changes which hidden states remain plausible.
sents.zh: 由于底层状态在每一步都会变化，智能体面临一个分支推断问题：每个动作和观测都会改变哪些隐藏状态仍然是可信的。

sents.en: Thus, instead of coverage over repeated episodes for a fixed z z , we need coverage over on-policy histories h t h_{t} across timesteps t ∈ [ H ] t\in[H] .
sents.zh: 因此，我们需要的不再是对固定 z z 的重复回合的覆盖，而是在时间步 t ∈ [ H ] t\in[H] 上对同策略历史 h t h_{t} 的覆盖。

paragraphs.en: In practice (see Algorithm 3 ), ASTEROID samples a timestep t t , rolls out the student to produce an on-policy history h t h_{t} , and queries the expert from the reached state, producing a partial trajectory that generates the queries o ∗ t : o^{*}_{t:} and action labels a ∗ t : a^{*}_{t:} (similar to takeovers in [ 36 ] ). The resulting tuples ( h t , o t : ∗ , a t : ∗ ) (h_{t},o^{*}_{t:},a^{*}_{t:}) train the policy to map its history to actions that are optimal for the hidden state under that history. At the takeover step, it approximates π ⁡ ( a t ∣ o t , h t ) = ∫ π ∗ ​ ( a t ∣ s t ) ​ p ​ ( s t ∣ o t , h t ) ​ d ​ s t \pi(a_{t}\mid o_{t},h_{t})=\int\pi^{*}(a_{t}\mid s_{t})\,p(s_{t}\mid o_{t},h_{t})\,ds_{t} , and over the future steps, the expert trajectory teaches it to follow one hypothesis rather than dithering. For example, in the maze, after each move, the local observations and rewards prune some possible positions while keeping others plausible. Further, we induce a curriculum in the context horizon by iteratively biasing the sampled timestep t t toward longer horizons. Thus, we adapt the method to a POMDP: collect on-policy histories, then use privileged labels to teach it how to guide future behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 在实践中（见算法3），ASTEROID 采样一个时间步 t t，让智能体（student）进行 rollout 以产生一条在策略历史 h t h_{t}，并从到达的状态向专家查询，生成一条部分轨迹，从中得到查询 o ∗ t : o^{*}_{t:} 和动作标签 a ∗ t : a^{*}_{t:}（类似于 [36] 中的接管）。 得到的元组 ( h t , o t : ∗ , a t : ∗ ) (h_{t},o^{*}_{t:},a^{*}_{t:}) 用于训练策略，使其将自身历史映射到在该历史下的隐藏状态上最优的动作。 在接管步骤，它近似 π ⁡ ( a t ∣ o t , h t ) = ∫ π ∗ ​ ( a t ∣ s t ) ​ p ​ ( s t ∣ o t , h t ) ​ d ​ s t \pi(a_{t}\mid o_{t},h_{t})=\int\pi^{*}(a_{t}\mid s_{t})\,p(s_{t}\mid o_{t},h_{t})\,ds_{t}，而在后续步骤中，专家轨迹教会它沿着某一个假设前进，而不是犹豫不决。 例如，在迷宫中，每走一步后，局部观测和奖励会排除一些可能的位置，同时使另一些位置仍然可信。 此外，我们通过迭代地将采样的时间步 t t 偏向更长的视野，在上下文视野维度上引入课程学习。 因此，我们将该方法适配到 POMDP：先收集在策略历史，再利用特权标签教会它如何引导未来行为。

paragraphs.en: In our experiments, we aim to answer the following questions:
paragraphs.zh: 在我们的实验中，我们旨在回答以下问题：

paragraphs.en: Does ASTEROID learn to solve partially observed problems efficiently on deployment?
paragraphs.zh: ASTEROID 能否在部署时高效地学习解决部分可观测的问题？

paragraphs.en: Is ASTEROID sample-efficient compared to baselines?
paragraphs.zh: 与基线相比，ASTEROID 的样本效率如何？

paragraphs.en: What kind of exploratory behavior do policies trained with ASTEROID display at test time?
paragraphs.zh: 用 ASTEROID 训练的智能体在测试时表现出什么样的探索行为？

paragraphs.en: Does ASTEROID learn exploration policies that can be deployed on real-robot hardware?
paragraphs.zh: ASTEROID 能否学习出可部署在真实机器人硬件上的探索策略？

paragraphs.en: Do frontier models perform in-context exploration?
paragraphs.zh: 前沿模型能否进行上下文内探索？

paragraphs.en: Is learning from on-policy contexts necessary to learn exploration efficiently?
paragraphs.zh: 从同策略（on-policy）上下文中学习对于高效地学习探索是否必要？

paragraphs.en: We evaluate our approach on a diverse suite of partially observable decision-making problems across robotic manipulation, discrete exploration, and continuous navigation (Figure 5 ), requiring strong elements of exploration, memory, and adaptation under limited sensing.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一组多样的部分可观测决策问题上评估了我们的方法，涵盖机器人操作、离散探索和连续导航（图5），这些问题在有限感知下需要较强的探索、记忆和适应能力。

paragraphs.en: Partially observed gridworlds [ 16 ] are a classic benchmark consisting of discrete search problems, where an agent acts over multiple episodes in a gridworld to reach one or more goals. The agent is in an n × n n\times n grid and must perform targeted exploration to solve the task, such as finding the hidden goal or sequentially finding the hidden key and the door across multiple episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 部分可观测网格世界[16]是一个经典的基准测试，由离散搜索问题组成，其中智能体在网格世界中跨越多个回合采取行动，以达成一个或多个目标。 智能体位于一个 n × n n\times n 的网格中，必须进行有针对性的探索来完成任务，例如找到隐藏的目标，或者在多个回合中依次找到隐藏的钥匙和门。

sents.en: Partially observed gridworlds [ 16 ] are a classic benchmark consisting of discrete search problems, where an agent acts over multiple episodes in a gridworld to reach one or more goals.
sents.zh: 部分可观测网格世界[16]是一个经典的基准测试，由离散搜索问题组成，其中智能体在网格世界中跨越多个回合采取行动，以达成一个或多个目标。

sents.en: The agent is in an n × n n\times n grid and must perform targeted exploration to solve the task, such as finding the hidden goal or sequentially finding the hidden key and the door across multiple episodes.
sents.zh: 智能体位于一个 n × n n\times n 的网格中，必须进行有针对性的探索来完成任务，例如找到隐藏的目标，或者在多个回合中依次找到隐藏的钥匙和门。

paragraphs.en: Meta-Learning navigation [ 57 ] is a meta-learning task where an agent must navigate in an environment to a hidden goal. We instantiate (i) Ant Navigation, where the agent is an 8-DoF robot, and (ii) 2D Navigation, which reduces the dynamics to a simple point mass.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习导航 [ 57 ] 是一项元学习任务，其中智能体必须在一个环境中导航至隐藏目标。 我们实例化了 (i) Ant Navigation，其中智能体是一个 8 自由度机器人；以及 (ii) 2D Navigation，它将动力学简化为一个简单的质点。

sents.en: Meta-Learning navigation [ 57 ] is a meta-learning task where an agent must navigate in an environment to a hidden goal.
sents.zh: 元学习导航 [ 57 ] 是一项元学习任务，其中智能体必须在一个环境中导航至隐藏目标。

sents.en: We instantiate (i) Ant Navigation, where the agent is an 8-DoF robot, and (ii) 2D Navigation, which reduces the dynamics to a simple point mass.
sents.zh: 我们实例化了 (i) Ant Navigation，其中智能体是一个 8 自由度机器人；以及 (ii) 2D Navigation，它将动力学简化为一个简单的质点。

paragraphs.en: Procgen Maze Navigation [ 18 ] involves finding the goal in procedurally generated mazes, where the agent receives only a local 3 × 3 3\times 3 observation and has to infer the maze layout and goal location using the interaction history.
paragraphs.zh: Procgen 迷宫导航 [ 18 ] 涉及在程序化生成的迷宫中寻找目标，其中智能体只能接收到局部 3 × 3 3\times 3 的观测，必须利用交互历史来推断迷宫布局和目标位置。

paragraphs.en: Embodied Object Search [ 56 ] involves searching for a household object in a fixed environment in Habitat-Sim. This presents a visually complex domain for a realistic partially observed problem.
paragraphs.zh: 具身目标搜索 [56] 涉及在 Habitat-Sim 的固定环境中搜索一个家庭物品。 这为一个真实的部分可观测问题提供了一个视觉上复杂的领域。

sents.en: Embodied Object Search [ 56 ] involves searching for a household object in a fixed environment in Habitat-Sim.
sents.zh: 具身目标搜索 [56] 涉及在 Habitat-Sim 的固定环境中搜索一个家庭物品。

sents.en: This presents a visually complex domain for a realistic partially observed problem.
sents.zh: 这为一个真实的部分可观测问题提供了一个视觉上复杂的领域。

paragraphs.en: Simulated Robotic Manipulation [ 75 ] tasks are high-dimensional, continuous-control manipulation tasks under partial observability: Wrist-Camera Peg-Insertion and Tactile-Pick. Here, the robot has to use limited sensing to manipulate objects, i.e., explore over the table using only the wrist view, or use touch sensing to locate the object and complete the given task.
paragraphs.zh: 模拟机器人操作任务[75]是部分可观测条件下的高维连续控制操作任务：腕部相机插销和触觉抓取。 在此，智能体需要利用有限的感知来操作物体，即仅通过腕部视角在桌面上进行探索，或利用触觉感知来定位物体并完成给定任务。

paragraphs.en: Real Robot Manipulation [ 78 , 8 ] : We reconstruct one of the simulated tasks in the real world, where the robot has to pick up a cube using proprioception from the arm and gripper only. We train policies in simulation with domain randomization [ 68 , 75 ] and then transfer them to the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 真实机器人操作 [78, 8]：我们在现实世界中重构了其中一个仿真任务，在该任务中，机器人仅需依靠机械臂和夹爪的本体感觉来抓取一个立方体。 我们在仿真中通过域随机化 [68, 75] 训练策略，然后将其迁移到现实世界。

paragraphs.en: We compare against ten strong baselines from several frameworks under partial observability:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在部分可观测性条件下，与来自多个框架的十个强基线进行了比较：

paragraphs.en: Asymmetric student–teacher: BC : imitates privileged expert trajectories, DAgger [ 59 ] : relabels the student’s per-step actions with the expert. DPT [ 42 ] trains a transformer on an in-context dataset of randomly collected interactions to predict oracle actions; SPOC [ 22 ] imitates shortest-path trajectories with data augmentation, yielding exploration-like behavior. AAWR [ 30 ] extends Advantage Weighted Regression [ 55 ] to POMDPs, using privileged state during training to learn a stronger critic.
paragraphs.zh: 非对称师生范式：BC：模仿特权专家轨迹；DAgger [ 59 ]：用专家对智能体的每步动作进行重标注。 DPT [ 42 ] 在随机收集交互构成的上文数据集上训练 Transformer 以预测先知动作；SPOC [ 22 ] 结合数据增强模仿最短路径轨迹，产生类似探索的行为。 AAWR [ 30 ] 将优势加权回归 [ 55 ] 扩展到 POMDP，在训练期间利用特权状态来学习更强的评论家。

sents.en: Asymmetric student–teacher: BC : imitates privileged expert trajectories, DAgger [ 59 ] : relabels the student’s per-step actions with the expert.
sents.zh: 非对称师生范式：BC：模仿特权专家轨迹；DAgger [ 59 ]：用专家对智能体的每步动作进行重标注。

sents.en: DPT [ 42 ] trains a transformer on an in-context dataset of randomly collected interactions to predict oracle actions; SPOC [ 22 ] imitates shortest-path trajectories with data augmentation, yielding exploration-like behavior.
sents.zh: DPT [ 42 ] 在随机收集交互构成的上文数据集上训练 Transformer 以预测先知动作；SPOC [ 22 ] 结合数据增强模仿最短路径轨迹，产生类似探索的行为。

sents.en: AAWR [ 30 ] extends Advantage Weighted Regression [ 55 ] to POMDPs, using privileged state during training to learn a stronger critic.
sents.zh: AAWR [ 30 ] 将优势加权回归 [ 55 ] 扩展到 POMDP，在训练期间利用特权状态来学习更强的评论家。

paragraphs.en: Meta-RL: RL 2 [ 21 ] trains a recurrent policy to adapt to the hidden parameters purely through interaction, treating the policy’s hidden state as an implicit learning algorithm that updates from histories across episodes. Distilled Planner [ 56 , 53 ] : For embodied navigation in Habitat, we train a policy that performs posterior-sampling RL (PSRL) [ 53 ] (i.e., upper bound performance).
paragraphs.zh: 元强化学习：RL² [21] 通过纯交互训练一个循环策略来适应隐藏参数，将策略的隐藏状态视为一种隐式的学习算法，跨回合从历史中进行更新。 蒸馏规划器 [56, 53]：对于 Habitat 中的具身导航，我们训练一个执行后验采样强化学习（PSRL）[53] 的策略（即上界性能）。

sents.en: Meta-RL: RL 2 [ 21 ] trains a recurrent policy to adapt to the hidden parameters purely through interaction, treating the policy’s hidden state as an implicit learning algorithm that updates from histories across episodes.
sents.zh: 元强化学习：RL² [21] 通过纯交互训练一个循环策略来适应隐藏参数，将策略的隐藏状态视为一种隐式的学习算法，跨回合从历史中进行更新。

sents.en: Distilled Planner [ 56 , 53 ] : For embodied navigation in Habitat, we train a policy that performs posterior-sampling RL (PSRL) [ 53 ] (i.e., upper bound performance).
sents.zh: 蒸馏规划器 [56, 53]：对于 Habitat 中的具身导航，我们训练一个执行后验采样强化学习（PSRL）[53] 的策略（即上界性能）。

paragraphs.en: Imitation-informed RL: BC+PPO [ 60 , 21 ] accelerates PPO [ 60 ] by adding a behavior-cloning loss over privileged actions; for meta-learning tasks, we use an adapted variant ( BC+RL 2 ) that leverages privileged supervision to bootstrap learning. ADVISOR [ 74 ] dynamically combines imitation learning (IL) and online RL objectives during training, resolving the imitation gap adaptively. RMA [ 38 ] learns to predict the privileged latent from history, and a frozen expert policy acts on that predicted latent.
paragraphs.zh: 模仿引导的强化学习：BC+PPO [60, 21] 通过在特权动作上添加行为克隆损失来加速 PPO [60]；对于元学习任务，我们使用一种改进变体（BC+RL 2），该变体利用特权监督来引导学习启动。 ADVISOR [74] 在训练过程中动态结合模仿学习（IL）与在线强化学习目标，自适应地解决模仿鸿沟问题。 RMA [38] 学习从历史信息中预测特权隐变量，冻结的专家智能体则基于该预测的隐变量进行决策。

sents.en: Imitation-informed RL: BC+PPO [ 60 , 21 ] accelerates PPO [ 60 ] by adding a behavior-cloning loss over privileged actions; for meta-learning tasks, we use an adapted variant ( BC+RL 2 ) that leverages privileged supervision to bootstrap learning.
sents.zh: 模仿引导的强化学习：BC+PPO [60, 21] 通过在特权动作上添加行为克隆损失来加速 PPO [60]；对于元学习任务，我们使用一种改进变体（BC+RL 2），该变体利用特权监督来引导学习启动。

sents.en: ADVISOR [ 74 ] dynamically combines imitation learning (IL) and online RL objectives during training, resolving the imitation gap adaptively.
sents.zh: ADVISOR [74] 在训练过程中动态结合模仿学习（IL）与在线强化学习目标，自适应地解决模仿鸿沟问题。

sents.en: RMA [ 38 ] learns to predict the privileged latent from history, and a frozen expert policy acts on that predicted latent.
sents.zh: RMA [38] 学习从历史信息中预测特权隐变量，冻结的专家智能体则基于该预测的隐变量进行决策。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 6 , we compare the test-time performance of in-context policies learned via ASTEROID against baselines. Given the same test-time budget, our method achieves substantially higher final performance. Unlike the baselines, ASTEROID’s on-policy data generation and expert supervision provide coverage over the context the policy sees and the subsequent actions it should take at deployment, i.e., it can effectively adapt its exploration using these contexts to infer task-relevant information. Figures 8 , 11 , and 16 show the same trend in partially observed navigation and manipulation. In Procgen Maze (Figure 6.5 ), ASTEROID solves procedurally generated mazes by using local observation history to maintain an implicit belief over the state, guiding exploration toward unexplored regions [ 35 ] . This avoids redundant search and enables ASTEROID to achieve higher success while being 2 × 2\times faster. In contrast, BC achieves non-trivial success through random exploration but does not use context to avoid redundant search, making it highly inefficient. DPT also underperforms because offline datasets provide incomplete coverage over test-time histories. For RMA, latent uncertainty generates out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs for the base policy, which is trained only under full observability. As a result, it never learns to explore. ASTEROID instead directly supervises the action distribution conditioned on the student’s own context to perform directed exploration. In ASTEROID, exploration is the learned behavior, not a byproduct. Finally, as we discuss in Appendix D , we see that DAgger under partial observability leads to performance degradation (below BC), while history conditioning and multi-step supervision in ASTEROID learn an effective search policy. We also show robustness to noisy experts in Appendix B.2 . Videos of the learned behavior are on the website 3 3 3 Project webpage: weirdlabuw.github.io/asteroid .

paragraphs.en: In this section, we compare the training-time sample efficiency of ASTEROID against baselines that combine RL with privileged supervision to learn policies under partial observability. Using GPU-parallelized simulation [ 48 ] , we evaluate manipulation tasks in which the policy has access to limited sensory modalities. In Figure 8 , ASTEROID is ∼ 100 × \sim 100\times more efficient in environment steps than RL baselines, learning a policy that explores and successfully picks the cube or inserts the peg. In Figure 16(b) , the student observes only the history of past actions and tactile sensing (no proprioception), and ASTEROID efficiently learns policies with ∼ 92 % \sim 92\% success rate under this partial observability. The supervised updates in ASTEROID (compared to expensive RL) make it highly efficient during training, even for high-dimensional tasks. While RL baselines can learn in low-dimensional settings (Appendix B.4 ), they are significantly sample-inefficient in domains such as ant navigation and robotics (Figures 8 and 11 ).
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将 ASTEROID 的训练时样本效率与结合强化学习与特权监督以在部分可观测条件下学习策略的基线方法进行比较。 利用 GPU 并行化仿真 [48]，我们评估了策略只能获取有限感知模态的操作任务。 在图 8 中，ASTEROID 在环境步数上的效率比强化学习基线高约 100 倍，能够学习到可以探索并成功抓起立方体或插入插销的策略。 在图 16(b) 中，学生智能体仅观察过去动作的历史和触觉感知（无本体感觉），ASTEROID 在这种部分可观测条件下高效地学习到了成功率约 92% 的策略。 ASTEROID 中的监督更新（相比于昂贵的强化学习）使其在训练期间非常高效，即使对于高维任务也是如此。 虽然强化学习基线可以在低维设置中学习（附录 B.4），但它们在蚂蚁导航和机器人等领域的样本效率显著低下（图 8 和图 11）。

paragraphs.en: In Tactile-Pick (Figure 9 ), the policy probes multiple grasp points and uses tactile feedback from failed attempts to inform its next actions, unlike BC, which treats trials independently and relies on i.i.d. exploration. Additionally, other baselines fail to learn directed exploration either because of incompatible supervision or inefficient context generation during training. Similarly, in Figure 11 , the robot policy scans the tabletop using its wrist camera to localize both the object and target. In contrast, naive distillation goes out of distribution and degenerates.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Tactile-Pick（图 9）中，策略会探测多个抓取点，并利用失败尝试中的触觉反馈来指导其后续动作，这与 BC 不同，BC 将各次尝试视为独立事件，并依赖独立同分布（i.i.d.）的探索。 此外，其他基线方法也未能学会有向探索，原因要么是监督信号不兼容，要么是训练期间上下文生成效率低下。 类似地，在图 11 中，机器人策略使用其腕部相机扫描桌面，以同时对物体和目标进行定位。 相比之下，朴素的蒸馏方法会偏离分布并退化。

paragraphs.en: We also see goal-directed, memory-based exploration (Appendix C.2 ) in Habitat and navigation tasks: the policy explores the environment, remembers failed locations, and avoids redundant search. See Appendix C and the website for videos. In Figure 11 , we observe in the Ant Navigation task that the learned exploration resembles strategies found in prior meta-learning methods [ 79 ] . The ant efficiently explores different goals and eliminates regions where it does not receive a high reward (see trajectories in Figure 11 ). This enables the agent to adaptively find the right goal and exploit it. Although RL can learn exploration, its sample inefficiency makes it impractical. DPT performs poorly in continuous control, as it is nearly impossible to construct offline datasets via random exploration that cover test-time histories.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还在 Habitat 和导航任务中观察到目标导向、基于记忆的探索（附录 C.2）：策略探索环境，记住失败的位置，并避免重复搜索。 视频见附录 C 和网站。 在图 11 中，我们观察到在蚂蚁导航任务中，学到的探索方式与先前元学习方法 [79] 中发现的策略相似。 蚂蚁高效地探索不同目标，并排除未获得高回报的区域（轨迹见图 11）。 这使智能体能够自适应地找到正确的目标并加以利用。 尽管强化学习可以学习探索，但其样本效率低下使其不具实用性。 DPT 在连续控制中表现不佳，因为几乎不可能通过随机探索构建覆盖测试时历史的离线数据集。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 12 , we evaluate ASTEROID on a real robot manipulation task that requires exploration under partial observability. We first train clairvoyant experts in Isaac Lab using large-scale reinforcement learning with domain randomization [ 75 , 78 ] . These experts use privileged state information to pick up a cube. At deployment, the real robot observes only proprioception (joint angles and gripper positions, no touch). The cameras are off, so it cannot see the cube, and vision-based transfer is not applicable. We train student policies to explore the world and infer this hidden information by trying different grasp locations and using gripper jaw position.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 12 中，我们在一个需要在部分可观测条件下进行探索的真实机器人操作任务上评估 ASTEROID。 我们首先在 Isaac Lab 中使用带域随机化的大规模强化学习训练全知专家。 这些专家利用特权状态信息来抓取立方体。 在部署时，真实机器人只能观察到本体感觉信息（关节角度和夹爪位置，没有触觉）。 摄像头是关闭的，因此它无法看到立方体，基于视觉的迁移也不适用。 我们训练学生策略去探索世界，通过尝试不同的抓取位置并利用夹爪钳口位置来推断这些隐藏信息。

paragraphs.en: The standard transfer baseline is to distill the simulation expert into the student policy via behavior cloning. This student policy imitates expert trajectories, but does not learn how to recover from failed attempts. In contrast, ASTEROID trains the policy to perform in-context exploration, so the robot learns to adapt its next grasp attempt based on the history of previous attempts. As shown in Figure 12 (right), ASTEROID achieves a higher success rate than behavior cloning. The qualitative rollouts in Figure 15 show this behavior: after a failed attempt, the baseline goes out of distribution, while ASTEROID continues searching over potential cube locations using its in-context abilities, completes the grasp, and successfully picks up the cube without cameras. We further demonstrate qualitatively that as the policy does not use vision, it can successfully solve the task in situations where the partial observability is natural, e.g., rummaging inside a box or under visual distractors (see robot videos on our website 4 4 4 Project webpage: weirdlabuw.github.io/asteroid ).
paragraphs.zh: 标准的迁移基线方法是通过行为克隆将仿真专家蒸馏到学生策略中。 该学生策略模仿专家轨迹，但无法学习如何从失败的尝试中恢复。 相比之下，ASTEROID 训练策略执行上下文内探索，因此机器人学会根据先前尝试的历史调整其下一次抓取尝试。 如图 12（右）所示，ASTEROID 实现了比行为克隆更高的成功率。 图 15 中的定性推演展示了这一行为：在一次失败的尝试后，基线方法偏离了分布，而 ASTEROID 利用其上下文内能力继续搜索立方体可能的位置，完成抓取，并在没有摄像头的情况下成功拾起立方体。 我们进一步定性地证明，由于该策略不使用视觉，它可以在部分可观测性是自然情况的环境中成功解决任务，例如在箱子内翻找或在视觉干扰物下操作（机器人视频见我们网站 4 4 4 项目网页：weirdlabuw.github.io/asteroid ）。

sents.zh: 图 15 中的定性推演展示了这一行为：在一次失败的尝试后，基线方法偏离了分布，而 ASTEROID 利用其上下文内能力继续搜索立方体可能的位置，完成抓取，并在没有摄像头的情况下成功拾起立方体。

sents.en: We further demonstrate qualitatively that as the policy does not use vision, it can successfully solve the task in situations where the partial observability is natural, e.g., rummaging inside a box or under visual distractors (see robot videos on our website 4 4 4 Project webpage: weirdlabuw.github.io/asteroid ).

paragraphs.en: Given recent progress in highly capable foundation models [ 2 ] , a natural question is: if we use frontier models for exploration in partially observed environments, how well do they perform? To investigate this, we conduct an experiment on the Peg-Insertion task where the robot has to use its wrist camera to explore the table, locate and pick up the peg, and insert it into the peg hole.

sents.en: To investigate this, we conduct an experiment on the Peg-Insertion task where the robot has to use its wrist camera to explore the table, locate and pick up the peg, and insert it into the peg hole.
sents.zh: 为了研究这个问题，我们在 Peg-Insertion 任务上进行了一项实验，在该任务中，智能体必须使用其腕部相机探索桌面，定位并拾起插销，然后将其插入插销孔中。

paragraphs.en: Following work on using foundation models to write code for controlling robots, e.g. , “code-as-policies” [ 43 , 14 ] , we first let a Claude Opus 5.5 coding agent (inside Claude Code) build a harness around the environment. Like ASTEROID, it has access to the full Isaac Lab environment and the privileged expert policy, which it uses to collect 3 demonstrations, train a perception model, and tune the prompt. We then use Claude Opus 5.5 as the policy: during each episode, we show it the camera images and robot state, and it writes a small program that controls the robot until the current sub-task ( e.g. , grasping the peg) is done, then looks again and writes the next subtask policy. Notably, directly using the model to output actions for this led to almost zero successes, as the model failed to precisely insert the peg. Under full observability, the model achieves a ∼ 65 % \sim 65\% success rate, below the expert policy ( ∼ 90 % \sim 90\% ), while also being ∼ 2 × \sim 2\times less efficient (see Figure 13 ). To adapt the policy to partial observability, we prompt the agent to tune the code policy to a wrist-camera-only setting (preserving the base controller it has generated). In the Wrist-Camera Peg-Insertion task, we see that our learned policy outperforms the frontier model ( ∼ 78 % \sim 78\% vs. ∼ 50 % \sim 50\% success rate). This implies that while frontier models are capable of completing tasks under full observability, the ability to explore via context is still missing from the repertoire of skills they have.
paragraphs.zh: 沿用利用基础模型编写控制机器人代码的工作，例如“code-as-policies” [43, 14]，我们首先让一个 Claude Opus 5.5 编码智能体（在 Claude Code 内部）围绕该环境构建一个测试框架。 与 ASTEROID 类似，它可以访问完整的 Isaac Lab 环境和特权专家策略，并利用这些来收集 3 个演示、训练感知模型以及调整提示词。 然后我们使用 Claude Opus 5.5 作为策略：在每个回合（episode）中，我们向它展示相机图像和机器人状态，它会编写一个小程序来控制机器人，直到当前子任务（例如抓取插销）完成，然后再观察并编写下一个子任务的策略。 值得注意的是，直接让模型输出动作来执行该任务几乎没有任何成功，因为模型无法精确地插入插销。 在完全可观测条件下，该模型达到了约 65% 的成功率，低于专家策略（约 90%），同时效率也低了约 2 倍（见图 13）。 为了使策略适应部分可观测条件，我们提示智能体将代码策略调整到仅使用腕部相机的设置（保留其已生成的基座控制器）。 在腕部相机插销插入任务中，我们看到我们学习到的策略优于前沿模型（约 78% 对约 50% 的成功率）。 这表明，尽管前沿模型能够在完全可观测条件下完成任务，但通过上下文进行探索的能力仍然不在它们所掌握的技能之列。

paragraphs.en: Across multiple domains, DPT performs poorly because offline random contexts fail to capture the deployment histories. In Figure 14 , we compare ASTEROID against AAWR [ 30 ] trained with offline datasets of varying diversity in the peg-insertion task, to highlight the importance of on-policy context collection. AAWR [ 30 ] , which learns from an offline dataset, is highly sensitive to the dataset quality and diversity. ASTEROID avoids this offline dependence by generating on-policy contexts from the student. This focuses supervision on deployment-relevant contexts, and is robust to imperfect expert labels (see Appendix B.2 ).

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose ASTEROID, an iterative asymmetric distillation framework for learning in-context exploration. The key idea is to train a history-conditioned policy using supervised targets from a privileged expert, while collecting the histories on-policy from the student. This directly addresses two bottlenecks for exploration: (i) privileged teachers do not demonstrate information-gathering behavior, and (ii) offline or randomly collected histories may not match the distribution the student will encounter at deployment. While the need for history-conditioned exploration policies is well established, we show that on-policy distillation from privileged teachers, without RL or latent regression, is sufficient to learn exploration scalably across diverse simulated and real-world tasks. We believe that as robots and AI agents are deployed in the wild, acting as web assistants or robot butlers, in-context exploration learned via simple and scalable online training is key to enabling truly autonomous behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 ASTEROID，一个用于学习上下文内探索的迭代式非对称蒸馏框架。 其核心思想是使用来自特权专家的监督目标来训练一个以历史为条件的策略，同时由学生智能体在策略上采集历史。 这直接解决了探索的两个瓶颈：(i) 特权教师不会示范信息收集行为，以及 (ii) 离线或随机采集的历史可能与学生智能体在部署时遇到的数据分布不匹配。 虽然对以历史为条件的探索策略的需求已被充分确立，但我们证明，来自特权教师的在策略蒸馏——无需强化学习或潜在回归——足以在多样的仿真和真实世界任务中可扩展地学习探索。 我们相信，随着机器人和人工智能智能体被部署到真实环境中，充当网页助手或机器人管家，通过简单且可扩展的在线训练学到的上下文内探索是实现真正自主行为的关键。

paragraphs.en: A limitation is that the approach relies on a strong privileged expert, though it is agnostic to how the expert is generated. An interesting direction is to remove this reliance and train experts from offline demonstrations. We note that posterior sampling exploration is not Bayes-optimal, i.e., it trades off some exploration efficiency for tractability and strong regret guarantees. This motivates future extensions that combine our approach with optimistic exploration. Another limitation is that this exploration relies on inferring hidden states from the overall expert support. When the hidden information can only be gathered outside this support, the student cannot reduce its uncertainty. A promising future direction is to learn a residual policy on top of this student to learn off-support information-gathering behavior. Additionally, the student policy is trained to imitate expert actions, but may produce unsafe exploration. Therefore, an important direction is to enforce safety via explicit constraints and safety filters.
paragraphs.zh: 一个局限性是该方法和特权专家依赖较强，不过它对专家是如何生成的并不敏感。 一个有趣的方向是消除这种依赖，并从离线示范中训练专家。 我们注意到，后验采样探索并非贝叶斯最优，即它以牺牲一定的探索效率来换取可处理性和强遗憾保证。 这启发我们在未来将本方法与乐观探索相结合进行扩展。 另一个局限性是这种探索依赖于从专家的整体支持集推断隐藏状态。 当隐藏信息只能在该支持集之外获取时，智能体无法降低其不确定性。 一个有前景的未来方向是在该智能体之上学习一个残差策略，以学习支持集之外的信息收集行为。 此外，学生策略被训练用于模仿专家动作，但可能产生不安全的探索。 因此，一个重要方向是通过显式约束和安全过滤器来保障安全性。

paragraphs.en: Student–Teacher Distillation. Learning from privileged experts arises in settings from self-driving [ 13 , 20 , 4 ] to robotic exploration [ 17 , 33 , 7 ] . In partially observed domains, interactive imitation learning addresses covariate shift and the resulting, compounding errors that drive the learner into unseen states [ 13 , 41 ] with classic iterative schemes including [ 19 , 59 , 58 , 64 ] . Recent results suggest that on-policy imitation is necessary under partial observability [ 65 ] , and that off-policy cloning [ 45 ] can fail in non-realizable settings where information-gathering behavior is required [ 63 , 74 ] . Our work targets this non-realizable regime: the learner must take information-gathering actions that are not directly recoverable from a fully observed expert [ 40 ] . Prior approaches handle this via additional assumptions (e.g., access to confounders at test time [ 66 ] or differentiable experts [ 73 ] ) or by incorporating reinforcement learning with bootstrapping via demonstrations or resets to induce exploration [ 49 , 70 , 30 , 74 , 37 ] . In contrast, we learn information-gathering behavior using iterative distillation conditioned on on-policy histories, which is substantially more stable and sample-efficient than RL-based alternatives.
paragraphs.zh: 学生–教师蒸馏。 从特权专家学习出现在从自动驾驶 [13, 20, 4] 到机器人探索 [17, 33, 7] 等多种场景中。 在部分可观测的领域中，交互式模仿学习可以应对协变量偏移以及由此导致的、会把学习者带入未见状态的累积误差 [13, 41]，经典的迭代方案包括 [19, 59, 58, 64]。 近期结果表明，在部分可观测条件下，同策略模仿是必要的 [65]，而在需要信息收集行为的不可实现设置中，离策略克隆 [45] 可能失败 [63, 74]。 我们的工作正是针对这种不可实现的情形：学习者必须采取那些无法从全观测专家那里直接恢复的信息收集动作 [40]。 已有方法通过附加假设来处理这一问题（例如在测试时可以获得混淆变量 [66]，或使用可微专家 [73]），或者通过结合强化学习，并借助示范或重置进行自举来诱导探索 [49, 70, 30, 74, 37]。 与之相反，我们以同策略历史为条件，使用迭代蒸馏来学习信息收集行为，这比基于强化学习的替代方法显著更加稳定且样本高效。

sents.zh: 我们的工作正是针对这种不可实现的情形：学习者必须采取那些无法从全观测专家那里直接恢复的信息收集动作 [40]。

sents.en: Prior approaches handle this via additional assumptions (e.g., access to confounders at test time [ 66 ] or differentiable experts [ 73 ] ) or by incorporating reinforcement learning with bootstrapping via demonstrations or resets to induce exploration [ 49 , 70 , 30 , 74 , 37 ] .
sents.zh: 已有方法通过附加假设来处理这一问题（例如在测试时可以获得混淆变量 [66]，或使用可微专家 [73]），或者通过结合强化学习，并借助示范或重置进行自举来诱导探索 [49, 70, 30, 74, 37]。

sents.en: In contrast, we learn information-gathering behavior using iterative distillation conditioned on on-policy histories, which is substantially more stable and sample-efficient than RL-based alternatives.
sents.zh: 与之相反，我们以同策略历史为条件，使用迭代蒸馏来学习信息收集行为，这比基于强化学习的替代方法显著更加稳定且样本高效。

paragraphs.en: Meta Learning. A common approach to learning in POMDPs is to use recurrent policies that compress the interaction history into a latent belief representation [ 28 , 31 ] . Meta-RL provides a general framework for learning adaptive exploration across task distributions [ 21 , 79 , 57 , 44 ] , but often requires extensive online training interaction [ 72 , 5 ] , making it difficult to scale to high-dimensional, sparse-reward domains with long-horizon credit assignment. Our approach replaces this expensive RL-based adaptation with iterative supervised learning, still enabling long-horizon, history-dependent exploration through on-policy context collection. Additionally, unlike prior work [ 42 , 79 , 21 , 40 ] , our method is not limited to Bayes-Adaptive MDPs [ 40 ] , where the agent interacts with an environment with a fixed underlying parameter across multiple episodes. We demonstrate that our method scales to POMDPs, in which the policy explores actions within a single episode to estimate the underlying state distribution and achieve task success.
paragraphs.zh: 元学习。 POMDP 中一种常见的学习方法是使用循环策略，将交互历史压缩为潜在信念表示 [ 28 , 31 ] 。 Meta-RL 为跨任务分布学习自适应探索提供了一个通用框架 [ 21 , 79 , 57 , 44 ] ，但通常需要大量的在线训练交互 [ 72 , 5 ] ，使其难以扩展到具有长时程信用分配的高维、稀疏奖励领域。 我们的方法用迭代式监督学习取代这种昂贵的基于强化学习的自适应，同时仍通过同策略上下文收集实现长时程、依赖历史的探索。 此外，与已有工作 [ 42 , 79 , 21 , 40 ] 不同，我们的方法不局限于贝叶斯自适应 MDP [ 40 ] ，即智能体在多个回合中与具有固定底层参数的环境进行交互。 我们证明了我们的方法可以扩展到 POMDP，其中策略在单个回合内探索动作以估计底层状态分布并实现任务成功。

paragraphs.en: Posterior Sampling. Posterior sampling methods [ 67 , 53 ] drive exploration by implicitly or explicitly maintaining a belief over the environment’s underlying hidden parameters, acting optimally under samples from this distribution, and updating the belief based on feedback. Despite strong empirical and theoretical results [ 10 , 53 ] , such approaches typically require maintaining and sampling from an explicit posterior, and solving for policies under the sampled parameters (e.g., PSRL, BOSS) [ 53 , 3 ] , limiting practicality in rich-observation settings. Recent approaches [ 62 , 76 ] learn Bayes-optimal policies for POMDPs but are applied in discrete settings, whereas posterior sampling yields a simple, scalable solution with provable regret guarantees. ASTEROID does not explicitly optimize a posterior-sampling objective, but in Section 6 we show that posterior-sampling-like behavior emerges naturally from our method through iterative on-policy distillation, even in high-dimensional continuous environments. Further, in Appendix H , we show that theoretically, ASTEROID converges to posterior sampling with linear regret akin to standard online learning methods [ 59 ] . We show that under stated assumptions, ASTEROID converges to posterior sampling on the covered history support. We also observe this behavior empirically in high-dimensional manipulation, and it transfers to a real robot (see Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 后验采样。 后验采样方法 [67, 53] 通过隐式或显式地维护关于环境底层隐藏参数的信念来驱动探索，在该分布的采样下采取最优行动，并基于反馈更新信念。 尽管有很强的实证与理论结果 [10, 53]，此类方法通常需要维护一个显式后验并从中采样，并在采样得到的参数下求解策略（例如 PSRL、BOSS）[53, 3]，这限制了其在丰富观测设定下的实用性。 近期方法 [62, 76] 学习 POMDP 的贝叶斯最优策略，但仅应用于离散设定，而后验采样则提供了一种简单、可扩展且具有可证明后悔保证的解决方案。 ASTEROID 并未显式优化后验采样目标，但在第 6 节中我们表明，即使在高维连续环境中，类似后验采样的行为也会通过迭代式在策略蒸馏从我们的方法中自然涌现。 此外，在附录 H 中，我们表明从理论上讲，ASTEROID 收敛到具有线性后悔的后验采样，类似于标准的在线学习方法 [59]。 我们证明在所述假设下，ASTEROID 在被覆盖的历史支撑集上收敛到后验采样。 我们还在高维操作任务中实证观察到这种行为，并且它可以迁移到真实机器人上（见第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: In-Context Decision-Making. Recent works [ 32 , 9 , 69 ] extensively use transformers as decision-making policies. When trained on a large corpus of sequential data using autoregressive supervised prediction, transformers can exhibit in-context learning [ 24 , 47 , 25 ] , i.e., adapting their behavior to new inputs based on interaction histories or input-output examples provided in context. In online decision-making, prior works have used these emergent capabilities to steer policies conditioned on rewards or prior context. For example, Decision Transformer (DT) [ 15 ] learns a transformer to autoregressively predict actions conditioned on past interactions and the desired return. Similarly, Algorithm Distillation [ 39 ] uses experience traces from a learning method (such as PPO [ 60 ] ) to adapt and improve policy behavior based on past contexts. More recently, Decision-Pretrained Transformer [ 42 ] shows that we can learn an in-context policy that performs posterior sampling in certain POMDPs. DPT generates the context using random interactions in the environment and action supervision from oracle experts with privileged information. Such methods assume that these offline datasets provide coverage over all possible histories of interaction, which is intractable and unrealistic in high-dimensional domains. ASTEROID, instead, uses a dataset of on-policy contexts, removing the coverage assumption and scaling to much harder and higher-dimensional problems (see Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: 上下文决策。 近期工作 [ 32 , 9 , 69 ] 广泛使用 Transformer 作为决策策略。 当通过自回归监督预测在大规模序列数据语料库上训练时，Transformer 可以表现出上下文学习 [ 24 , 47 , 25 ] 能力，即根据上下文中提供的交互历史或输入-输出示例来调整其对新输入的行为。 在在线决策中，先前的工作利用这些涌现能力来引导以奖励或先验上下文为条件的策略。 例如，Decision Transformer (DT) [ 15 ] 学习一个 Transformer，以过去交互和期望回报为条件来自回归地预测动作。 类似地，Algorithm Distillation [ 39 ] 使用某个学习方法（例如 PPO [ 60 ] ）的经验轨迹，基于过去的上下文来调整和改进策略行为。 最近，Decision-Pretrained Transformer [ 42 ] 表明我们可以学习一个在某些 POMDP 中执行后验采样的上下文策略。 DPT 利用环境中的随机交互以及来自拥有特权信息的专家智能体的动作监督来生成上下文。 这类方法假设这些离线数据集覆盖了所有可能的交互历史，这在高维领域是不可行且不现实的。 相反，ASTEROID 使用由同策略上下文组成的数据集，去除了覆盖假设，并能扩展到更困难、更高维的问题（见第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 16 , we show the performance of our proposed method across additional partially observed environments. ASTEROID leverages on-policy context accumulation and expert supervision to solve these tasks efficiently. In the Tactile-Pick w/o Proprioception task, the objective is to pick a randomly placed cube on the table. The arm is randomly initialized, and the only observation available to the student is tactile forces and the last action. We observe that ASTEROID effectively solves the high-dimensional POMDP task with ∼ 92 % \sim 92\% success by implicitly maintaining a belief over the underlying state. We plot the performance over iterations and the resulting behavior in Figure 16(b) . Note that in the tactile-pick (and some other) tasks, BC while history-conditioned is not efficient and achieves non-trivial performance (here, ∼ 48 % \sim 48\% ) because certain evaluation reset conditions do not require significant or directed exploration to locate the object.
paragraphs.zh: 在图16中，我们展示了所提出方法在更多部分可观测环境中的性能。 ASTEROID 利用同策略上下文积累与专家监督来高效解决这些任务。 在 Tactile-Pick w/o Proprioception 任务中，目标是从桌面上抓取一个随机放置的立方体。 机械臂以随机状态初始化，学生智能体唯一可用的观测是触觉力与上一步动作。 我们观察到，ASTEROID 通过隐式维护对底层状态的信念，以约 92% 的成功率有效解决了高维 POMDP 任务。 我们在图16(b)中绘制了性能随迭代次数的变化以及最终产生的行为。 注意，在 tactile-pick（以及其他一些）任务中，基于历史条件的 BC 效率不高，但能达到不平凡的性能（此处约 48%），这是因为某些评估重置条件不需要大量的或定向的探索来定位物体。

paragraphs.en: At each iteration k < K k<K , the policy interacts with the environment for k k episodes, thereby inducing an increasing curriculum on on-policy rollout horizons. As the context window gradually expands, it allows the student to use longer histories to rule out hidden states or task instances inconsistent with its observations and feedback (Appendix B.5 ). The curriculum also avoids a subtle distribution-shift issue. Suppose the maximum context length is K K , and we roll out an intermediate policy π θ k \pi_{\theta_{k}} for more than k k episodes. Since π θ k \pi_{\theta_{k}} was only trained on contexts of length at most k k , maintaining an in-distribution context would require a sliding window over the most recent k k episodes. However, this window can discard early exploration outcomes. If a failed goal is no longer in context, the policy may re-explore it, producing redundant exploration histories that a fully converged policy would not generate. Informally, this reduces the effective number of length- H H exploration contexts from | 𝒵 | H |\mathcal{Z}|^{H} arbitrary failure sequences to at most | 𝒵 | ! ( | 𝒵 | − H ) ! \frac{|\mathcal{Z}|!}{(|\mathcal{Z}|-H)!} ordered non-redundant histories. This further reduces the effective context space, thereby making ASTEROID sample-efficient.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次迭代 k < K 时，策略与环境交互 k 个回合，从而在 on-policy rollout 的回合范围上形成逐步递增的课程。 随着上下文窗口逐渐扩大，学生模型可以利用更长的历史来排除与其观测和反馈不一致的隐藏状态或任务实例（附录 B.5）。 该课程还避免了一个微妙的分布偏移问题。 假设最大上下文长度为 K，而我们将中间策略 π_{θ_k} rollout 超过 k 个回合。 由于 π_{θ_k} 仅在长度至多为 k 的上下文上训练过，要保持上下文处于分布内，就需要对最近 k 个回合使用滑动窗口。 然而，这个窗口可能会丢弃早期的探索结果。 如果某个失败的目标不再位于上下文中，策略可能会重新探索它，从而产生完全收敛的策略不会生成的冗余探索历史。 非形式化地说，这会把长度为 H 的有效探索上下文数量从 |𝒵|^H 个任意失败序列减少到至多 |𝒵|! 个。 （即 |𝒵|!/(|𝒵|−H)! 个）有序且无冗余的历史。 这进一步缩小了有效上下文空间，从而使 ASTEROID 具有样本高效性。

sents.en: At each iteration k < K k<K , the policy interacts with the environment for k k episodes, thereby inducing an increasing curriculum on on-policy rollout horizons.
sents.zh: 在每次迭代 k < K 时，策略与环境交互 k 个回合，从而在 on-policy rollout 的回合范围上形成逐步递增的课程。

sents.en: As the context window gradually expands, it allows the student to use longer histories to rule out hidden states or task instances inconsistent with its observations and feedback (Appendix B.5 ).
sents.zh: 随着上下文窗口逐渐扩大，学生模型可以利用更长的历史来排除与其观测和反馈不一致的隐藏状态或任务实例（附录 B.5）。

sents.en: The curriculum also avoids a subtle distribution-shift issue.
sents.zh: 该课程还避免了一个微妙的分布偏移问题。

sents.en: Suppose the maximum context length is K K , and we roll out an intermediate policy π θ k \pi_{\theta_{k}} for more than k k episodes.
sents.zh: 假设最大上下文长度为 K，而我们将中间策略 π_{θ_k} rollout 超过 k 个回合。

sents.en: Since π θ k \pi_{\theta_{k}} was only trained on contexts of length at most k k , maintaining an in-distribution context would require a sliding window over the most recent k k episodes.
sents.zh: 由于 π_{θ_k} 仅在长度至多为 k 的上下文上训练过，要保持上下文处于分布内，就需要对最近 k 个回合使用滑动窗口。

sents.en: However, this window can discard early exploration outcomes.
sents.zh: 然而，这个窗口可能会丢弃早期的探索结果。

sents.en: If a failed goal is no longer in context, the policy may re-explore it, producing redundant exploration histories that a fully converged policy would not generate.
sents.zh: 如果某个失败的目标不再位于上下文中，策略可能会重新探索它，从而产生完全收敛的策略不会生成的冗余探索历史。

sents.en: Informally, this reduces the effective number of length- H H exploration contexts from | 𝒵 | H |\mathcal{Z}|^{H} arbitrary failure sequences to at most | 𝒵 | !
sents.zh: 非形式化地说，这会把长度为 H 的有效探索上下文数量从 |𝒵|^H 个任意失败序列减少到至多 |𝒵|! 个。

sents.en: ( | 𝒵 | − H ) ! \frac{|\mathcal{Z}|!}{(|\mathcal{Z}|-H)!} ordered non-redundant histories.
sents.zh: （即 |𝒵|!/(|𝒵|−H)! 个）有序且无冗余的历史。

sents.en: This further reduces the effective context space, thereby making ASTEROID sample-efficient.
sents.zh: 这进一步缩小了有效上下文空间，从而使 ASTEROID 具有样本高效性。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 17 (right), we compare the performance of ASTEROID across two different schedules: (i) No-Curriculum: the exploration horizon is sampled from a fixed range across all iterations, and (ii) Curriculum: the exploration horizon is sampled from a range that increases every iteration. We observe that curriculum-based exploration is more efficient than the non-curriculum variant, as it keeps student policy rollouts in distribution and makes on-policy data generation more sample-efficient. Furthermore, in Figure 17 (middle), we compare the robustness of the method across different values of increasing curriculum and observe that it is relatively insensitive to this parameter.
paragraphs.zh: 在图17（右）中，我们比较了ASTEROID在两种不同课程安排下的性能：(i) 无课程：在所有迭代中，探索视野都从一个固定范围内采样；(ii) 有课程：探索视野从一个随每次迭代递增的范围内采样。 我们观察到，基于课程的探索比无课程的变体更高效，因为它使学员策略的轨迹采样保持在分布内，并使在策略数据生成更具样本效率。 此外，在图17（中）中，我们比较了该方法在不同递增课程取值下的鲁棒性，并观察到它对该参数相对不敏感。

paragraphs.en: In Figures 6 and 8 , we observe that RL-based baselines (RL 2 , BC+RL 2 , and ADVISOR) severely underperform in some long-horizon sparse reward tasks. To further ablate this, we run the RL baselines and our method in a smaller version of the Darkroom environment, where the grid size is 5 × 5 5\times 5 . We observe that RL baselines learn competitive search policies in these small-scale environments. ASTEROID uses supervised learning to model expert actions while building exploration context via student rollouts, rather than relying on expert supervision and dynamic programming over random contexts to learn how to explore and exploit information. As a result, ASTEROID performs better than RL baselines in high-dimensional, long-horizon settings.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 6 和图 8 中，我们观察到基于强化学习的基线方法（RL²、BC+RL² 和 ADVISOR）在某些长时程稀疏奖励任务中表现严重不佳。 为了进一步消融验证这一点，我们在一个较小版本的暗室环境中运行了强化学习基线方法和我们的方法，该环境的网格大小为 5×5。 我们观察到，强化学习基线方法在这些小规模环境中能够学到具有竞争力的搜索策略。 ASTEROID 使用监督学习来建模专家动作，同时通过学生 rollout 构建探索上下文，而不是依赖专家监督和对随机上下文进行动态规划来学习如何探索与利用信息。 因此，ASTEROID 在高维、长时程的设置中表现优于强化学习基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Figure 16(c) shows exploration performance as a function of the number of in-context exploration iterations on a high-dimensional navigation task. In Habitat Object Search, performance improves steadily as additional exploration steps allow the policy to gather informative observations and refine its behavior, despite the complexity of the observations, almost converging to the posterior-sampling upper bound. Further, in Figure 19 , we observe that the test-time efficiency of ASTEROID improves significantly with more iterations. These results indicate that ASTEROID effectively uses in-context interaction to accumulate task-relevant information, translating additional exploration into improved downstream task performance in realistic, partially observable environments, such as higher success rates in embodied object search in Habitat and in robot manipulation tasks. In Appendix B.3 , we further include ablations showing the benefits and robustness of ASTEROID to the curriculum over exploration horizon across multiple iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 图 16(c) 展示了在高维导航任务中，探索性能随上下文内探索迭代次数的变化情况。 在 Habitat 物体搜索任务中，随着额外的探索步骤使策略能够收集有信息量的观测并改进其行为，性能稳步提升，尽管观测十分复杂，几乎收敛到后验采样上界。 此外，在图 19 中，我们观察到 ASTEROID 的测试时效率随迭代次数增加而显著提升。 这些结果表明，ASTEROID 有效地利用上下文内交互来积累与任务相关的信息，将额外的探索转化为在真实部分可观测环境中下游任务性能的提升，例如在 Habitat 具身物体搜索和机器人操作任务中更高的成功率。 在附录 B.3 中，我们进一步包含了消融实验，展示 ASTEROID 对跨多次迭代的探索视野课程设置的优势和鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: In Figure 20 , we additionally measure how far generalization extends. In the 2D Navigation task, training goals are sampled on a semicircle of radius 0.7 from the origin, and at evaluation we sample goals at increasing radii from 0.7 (in-distribution) to 1.0 (far out-of-distribution), keeping the dynamics and observations unchanged. This isolates the shift to the latent (goal) distribution alone. As shown in Figure 20 , ASTEROID retains near-optimal performance near the training distribution (normalized return of 0.99 at radius 0.7 and 0.98 at 0.75) and degrades gradually as the goals move farther away (0.41 at radius 1.0). Generally, amortized POMDP solvers [ 42 , 53 , 23 ] that are learned via interaction or offline datasets suffer from a decline in performance as the train and test distributions diverge, and this observation is consistent with past results [ 51 , 77 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在图 20 中，我们进一步测量了泛化的延伸范围。 在 2D 导航任务中，训练目标是从以原点为圆心、半径为 0.7 的半圆上采样的，而在评估时，我们在从 0.7（分布内）到 1.0（远超出分布）逐渐增大的半径上采样目标，同时保持动力学和观测不变。 这样就将偏移单独隔离为潜在（目标）分布的变化。 如图 20 所示，ASTEROID 在接近训练分布处保持接近最优的性能（半径 0.7 处归一化回报为 0.99，0.75 处为 0.98），并随着目标远离而逐渐下降（半径 1.0 处为 0.41）。 总体而言，通过交互或离线数据集学习得到的摊销式 POMDP 求解器 [ 42 , 53 , 23 ] 在训练分布与测试分布发生偏离时会出现性能下降，这一观察与以往结果一致 [ 51 , 77 ]。

paragraphs.en: In Figures 11 and 21 , we further compare the qualitative exploration behavior across the Peg-Insertion and 2D Navigation tasks. We observe that ASTEROID enables active exploration-like behavior during manipulation, in which the robot arm moves efficiently across the table to locate the peg and the target. Similarly, in the 2D navigation maze task, ASTEROID learns a policy that adaptively searches for the goal in unexplored regions and converges to high reward in subsequent episodes once it can identify the goal region from past trials. We include full videos of the policies on our website 5 5 5 Project webpage: weirdlabuw.github.io/asteroid , which also includes goal-directed exploration across different rooms in Habitat.
paragraphs.zh: 在图 11 和图 21 中，我们进一步比较了插销插入任务和二维导航任务中的定性探索行为。 我们观察到，ASTEROID 能够在操作过程中实现类似主动探索的行为，机械臂在桌面上高效移动以定位插销和目标。 类似地，在二维导航迷宫任务中，ASTEROID 学到的策略能够在未探索区域自适应地搜索目标，并在后续回合中一旦能从过去的尝试中识别出目标区域，就收敛到高奖励。 我们在项目网页上提供了策略的完整视频（网址：weirdlabuw.github.io/asteroid），其中还包含在 Habitat 中跨不同房间的目标导向探索。

paragraphs.en: To investigate whether the policy learned with ASTEROID actually attends to context, we construct a variant of the Key-Door environment in which the agent observes two boolean flags in its state whenever it lands on the key or the door during exploration. Policies trained with ASTEROID exhibit emergent in-context memory. If the agent discovered the key or door in earlier attempts, it can later retrieve that information from context and use it efficiently.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究通过 ASTEROID 学到的策略是否真的会关注上下文，我们构建了一个 Key-Door（钥匙-门）环境的变体：当智能体在探索过程中到达钥匙或门的位置时，其状态中会观察到两个布尔标志。 使用 ASTEROID 训练的策略表现出涌现的上下文内记忆。 如果智能体在较早的尝试中发现了钥匙或门，它之后可以从上下文中检索该信息并高效地加以利用。
